thread:
incident-bot: [PAGER] High error budget burn detected for /v1/generate (hosted-us). 5xx rate spiked to 12% over 5m, automated failover to fallback-models triggered repeatedly. Potential cascading retries observed. Paging oncall.
oncall-jordan: Seeing it. Root cause hint: smart-routing sending traffic to fallback region/model variants. Paging SRE lead @sre-lead. :rotating_light:
lia: I can take it, oncall-jordan. Oncall switched to me? Pls handoff.
oncall-jordan: Handoff -> lia. Key notes: clients are retrying aggressively (0,100,200ms backoffs), routing policy fallback is configured with no jitter. Fallbacks spin up extra pods in eu-west causing cross-region egress to our hosted pool. Full context in logs below.
lia: grabbing logs now. Quick grep:
```
[2026-03-15T09:10:02Z] route-evaluator: chosen_variant=experimental-v2-8bit fallback_triggered=true
[2026-03-15T09:10:03Z] proxy: upstream_fail count=4, routed_to=eu-west-1
[2026-03-15T09:10:04Z] client: retry=1, backoff_ms=0, id=cli-97
```
lia: That 0ms backoff is brutal. Clients re-sending immediately, server failover then routes to eu-west which is slower -> more client retries -> thundering herd.
raj: On it. Can we temporarily disable cross-region fallback for hosted tier? That should stop the amplification.
maria: Also see an increase in model variant mismatch errors. Some requests expect v1-tokenizer but routed to v2-quantized -> 400s. That increases retry logic on client side.
lia: Proposed immediate mitigations:
- Lock routing to same-region for 15m: `PATCH /admin/routing/policies/{policy_id}` set `allow_cross_region: false`
- Reduce automatic failover concurrency to 1
- Add jitter to fallback policy via `fallback_backoff_jitter = true`
- Throttle incoming retries at edge for clients with >10 req/s
oncall-jordan: +1. Doable now? I can run the patch.
lia: I'll prepare the patch and post command. Also alert support to notify customers with visible impact if needed.
lia: Running:
```
curl -X PATCH "https://console.internal/api/routing/policies/rdw-smart-01" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"allow_cross_region": false, "max_failover_concurrency":1}'
```
sre-lead: Heads up — be careful with full disable of fallback, some customers rely on it. We should scope to hosted-us and low-latency routes only.
lia: Good call. scoping now to `region: us-*` and `tier: hosted`.
infra-ops: I can spin up extra local capacity in us-east to absorb traffic while we stabilize. Doing `kubectl scale deployment/inference-us-east --replicas=8`.
lia: After policy patch and throttles, I'm also applying an edge rate limit rule to cap per-IP retries: `edge.rules.add("retry_rate_limit", "10/s")`.
support-amy: I put a status note in status.redwood.ai: "Degraded performance for text-generation endpoints in hosted-us due to routing failover. Engineers investigating." Customers flagged two higher-tier accounts; notifying them directly.
raj: Confirming metrics — CPU on fallback nodes dropped 45% after patch. Retry rate fell from 1200/s to 320/s in 8m. Error rate trending down.
oncall-jordan: Nice. Any residual customer impact?
support-amy: Some request latencies still high for requests that hit quantized variants. We're routing those to stable v1 for the affected customers.
lia: Root cause summary so far: 1) routing policy allowed cross-region fallback without jitter; 2) clients implemented aggressive immediate retries on 4xx/5xx; 3) fallback chose incompatible model variant for some requests -> more retries; combined effects produced amplification loop.
lia: Next steps (post-mitigation)
- Add jitter and exponential backoff recommendation to SDK docs and push a patch to SDKs to enable default jitter
- Add a server-side retry token bucket that rejects immediate retries from same client
- Add a routing policy guard that prevents variant mismatch fallback (variant-compat checks)
- Post-incident blameless review tomorrow 10:30am PT
sre-lead: Agree. Also schedule a canary test for any routing policy change.
oncall-jordan: Incident declared resolved for now. Will monitor for 2h before fully closing the page. Thanks everyone. :clap:
incident-bot: Incident resolved: paging cleared. Duration 00:42:45. Links: https://ops.internal/incidents/1965432100
maria: Filing a follow-up ticket to add variant-compat validation: INF-3241
lia: Thanks team. I'll write the incident timeline and send to #postmortems after the blameless review.
support-amy: I'll follow up with the affected customers with a short RCA once we have the timeline.
oncall-jordan: Closing handoff to lia, monitoring escalations. :lock_with_ink_pen:
